set.body: Implement a JVM Glasser loader with explicit source choice, stable label parsing, confidence/provenance recording, and no silent source downgrade without metadata. Tests should use local fixtures and leave live-download checks optional. Likely paths: modules/atlas/jvm/src/main/scala/scalafim/atlas/io/GlasserLoader.scala, modules/atlas/jvm/src/test/scala/scalafim/atlas/io.
set.title: Glasser HCP-MMP1.0 volumetric atlas loader
